the ICESat GLAS laser altimetry data are more accurate than the SRTM90 DEM, and that the ICESAT/GLASS data are more reliable than the SRT90 data in high mountain areas.
the elevation data from the ICESat mission can be used as a reliable source to determine elevation on the East Tibetan plateau.

the ICESat data are a valuable source to derive elevation data for remote areas, which are not covered by SRTM90.
the ICESat/ GLAS data can be used to determine elevations in the Tibetan Plateau with a high accuracy.

the ICESat GLAS heights are reliable and can be used for further analyses in remote areas.
